extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: crooked witch cottage, approx. 5.6 x 4.9 x 6.4 m (walls 4.4 x 3.6 m)
extras.notes: front faces -Y; small crooked cottage: ivory plaster over a rubble-stone plinth with dark timber frame, very steep purple roof with a sagging ridge and soft shingle rows whose right end droops like a witch hat, crooked stacked stone chimney with a pot, round windows with warm glowing panes ('witch-cottage_window_glow', solid emissive, not baked), arched door with iron straps, gold crescent moon and ring, stone step, three pumpkins, a broom leaning on the wall, moss. Movable part: 'witch-cottage_door' (origin on the left hinge axis; rotate about local Z, negative angles (about -100 degrees) open it outwards); no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
